label: Joint-absence and total-noncreation powers are independent as typed; both bridges are needed
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, finite controls with GOD_4 read as the holder g and the possibility reading of PowerFor (y has at w a power for p when p holds at an accessible world where y exists). (1) On a three-world frame (no creature, c, d) the total-noncreation power, Euclidean access, monotone powers and 0050b6ed's proposition all hold. (2) On the replacement frame (g gives c at false and d at true) 0050b6ed's proposition, Euclidean access and monotone powers hold, the total-noncreation power fails, g gives something at every accessible world and #1897's ActualAbsenceByWithholding holds. (3) On a non-Euclidean frame (a sees b, e1, e2; each sees only itself; c absent only at e1, d only at e2) with g necessary at a, the total-noncreation power and monotone powers hold and 0050b6ed's proposition fails. (4) On the three-world frame with a non-monotone, maximally specific power the total-noncreation power and Euclidean access hold and 0050b6ed's proposition fails. So the two powers are independent as typed; only the bundle with Euclidean access and monotone powers entails 0050b6ed. Each model witnesses only its formal interpretation; the possibility reading has no causal content, the maximally specific power is an encoding artifact, and recipients are rigid (provenance individuation).
